{{Quote|Fountain Security to unknown vessel. You are approaching within five kilometers of the Fountain. Please alter your course.|Fountain Security to the ''Starstalker''|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>}}
'''Fountain Security''' was an organization located on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]], which served as a security measure for the sacred [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Ancients]]. In [[44 ABY]], Fountain Security attempted to no avail to deter the ''[[Starstalker]]'' from approaching and [[Violation|violating]] the Fountain.
